title: Does the agent team justify its cost?
description: Compare C0 fixed workflow, C1 single agent with all tools, and C2 specialist team under the same model, tools, and budget. Preserve safety and approval controls in every configuration.
development_result: Journey-wired free-Nemotron team-override live: 79/79 task_success all arms; C1/C2 median latency ~0.85s vs C0 ~0.02s (models engaged; OpenRouter usage callbacks undercount tokens on this path). Prior gpt-4o-mini ad-hoc C1 set still shows C2 costing more ($0.0115 vs $0.0033). Held-out local custody n=40 scored via --held-out. Not a specialist-team quality win.
blocker: Final PDF still needs independent dual labels on held-out, R1/R3 threshold sign-off, and three frozen held-out repeats. Lead+R5 report-only thresholds and journey-wired live/HO-path evidence are recorded.
